sentences.en: It is cruel of you to find fault with her.
sentences.zh: 你批评她的行为太残忍了。

sentences.en: We love the man all the better for his faults.
sentences.zh: 正因为他的缺点，我们更加爱他。

sentences.en: I do not love him the less for his faults.
sentences.zh: 他的缺点并没有减少我对他的喜爱。

senses.zh: 故障；毛病；缺点；错误；[地]断层；（网球等）发球失误
（通常用于疑问句或否定句）挑剔
